instruction: Review the committed change benchmark-base..HEAD without modifying or staging files. cache.cache_key(url, headers, vary) must return [url, pairs], where pairs contains every distinct Vary header name lowercased and sorted, with its matching case-insensitive request-header value (or empty string when absent). Input header names are unique ignoring case. Different selected header values must produce different keys; unselected headers must not affect keys. Report only actionable defects introduced by the candidate; do not report style preferences.
